name: The Wind Breaker
description: Riding the wind and waves is a "ship in the sky" made with Pinku's ingenuity. The whole ship is decorated with black gold and bright red accents. The pavilions and pavilions on the ship are as bright as a fairy palace. The soaring dragon and auspicious cloud patterns are integrated into exquisite details, which means auspiciousness descending from the sky and endless blessings. Set sail, it rolls up layers of huge waves, like a dragon in the rapids, breaking through the waves and riding the wind, majestic! I convey to you my best wishes for smooth sailing, full of good luck, and overwhelming success.
